address: Rua do Monte Olivete 32 A, Lisbon, 1200-280, Portugal
bio: A cosy restaurant next to the National Museum of Natural History and Science that became famous after Chef Louise Bourrat won the French 2022 edition of Top Chef! It boasts a young international team (they speak up to seven languages here) that delivers a modern, globetrotting cuisine of pampered textures that exudes femininity. Reserved exclusively for dinner service, the offer comes as a single tasting menu called Colheita (available in seven or ten courses and also in a vegetarian version), which is reborn with every change of season. A dish that enchanted us? ‘Polvo Monocromático’ (monochrome octopus) served with harissa aioli, roast sweet potato and bordelaise sauce made from the octopus' own broth....
